ζαησ.g: [ζα- + ἠ-, ἄημι.] Acc. ζαῆν Od. 12.313. Blowing strongly, furious, blustering Il. 12.157: Od. 5.368, Od. 12.313.

ζαθεοσ.g: -η [ζα- + θεῖος.] Holy, sacred. Like ἠγάθεος, epithet of places Il. 1.38 = 452, Il. 2.508, 520, Il. 9.151 = 293, Il. 15.432.

ζατρεφησ.g: [ζα- + τρέφω.] Well-nourished, goodly Od. 4.451, Od. 14.19, 106. Of, prepared from, such an animal: σάκος ταύρων ζατρεφέων Il. 7.223.

ζαφλεγησ.g: [ζα- + φλέγω.] Full of fire or life. Of men Il. 21.465.

ζαχρηησ.g: ζαχρειής [ζα- (perh.) χράω2. Fierce in attack.] 1 Furious or formidable in fight Il. 12.347 = 360, Il. 13.684. 2 Of winds, furious, blustering Il. 5.525.

ζειαι.g: αἱ. Some kind of grain Od. 4.41. The growing plant Od. 4.604.

ζειδωροσ.g: -ον [ζειαί + δωρέομαι.] Grain-giving. Epithet of the earth Il. 2.548, Il. 8.486, Il. 20.226: Od. 3.3 = Od. 12.386, Od. 4.229, Od. 5.463, Od. 7.332, Od. 9.357, Od. 11.309, Od. 13.354, Od. 19.593.

ζευγλη.g: -ης, ἡ [ζευγ-, ζεύγνυμι.] A cushion fastened under the yoke to prevent chafing, a yoke-cushion Il. 17.440, Il. 19.406.

ζευγοσ.g: τό [ζεύγνυμι.] A team of draught-animals: ζεύγεα ἐλάστρεον Il. 18.543.

ζεφυριη.g: ἡ [fem. of adj. fr. Ζέφυρος.] = Ζέφυρος. Od. 7.119.

ζεω.g: 3 sing. aor. ζέσσε Il. 18.349: Od. 10.360. Of water, to boil up, boil: ἐπεὶ ζέσσεν ὕδωρ (had come to the boil) Il. 18.349: = Od. 10.360. Of the containing caldron: ὡς λέβης ζεῖ ἔνδον Il. 21.362. Of the waters of a river exposed to fire Il. 21.365.

ζηλημων.g: -ονος [ζῆλος, jealousy.] Jealous, envious: σχέτλιοί ἐστε, θεοί, ζηλήμονες Od. 5.118.

ζητεω.g: [cf. δίζημαι, δίζω.] To seek, seek for: ἔμʼ ἔξοχα πάντων ζήτει Il. 14.258.

ζοφοσ.g: -ου, ὁ. Darkness, gloom. 1 The gloom of the nether world: ἀναστήσονται ὑπὸ ζόφου Il. 21.56. Cf. Il. 23.51: Od. 11.57, 155, Od. 20.356. The nether world: αΐδης ἔλαχε ζόφον Il. 15.191. 2 The gloom into which the sun appears to set Od. 3.335. The region of darkness, the quarter of the setting sun, the west: σπέος πρὸς ζόφον εἰς Ἔρεβος τετραμμένον (i.e., app., facing west with an internal downward direction) Od. 12.81. Contrasted with ἠώς Od. 10.190. With ἠώς τʼ ἠέλιός τε Il. 12.240: Od. 9.26, Od. 13.241.

ζυγοδεσμον.g: τό [ζυγόν + δεσμός.] A yoke-fastening, the rope or thong by which the yoke was secured to the pole Il. 24.270.

ζυγον.g: -οῦ, τό [cf. L. jugum, Eng. yoke.] Ablative ζυγόφι(ν) Il. 19.404, Il. 24.576. 1 A yoke for draught-animals Il. 5.730, 731, Il. 8.543, Il. 16.470, Il. 24.268, etc.: Od. 3.383, 486 = Od. 15.184, Od. 4.39. 2 In pl., oarsmen's benches extending from side to side of a ship: ὑπὸ ζυγὰ δῆσα [ἑτάρους] Od. 9.99. Cf. Od. 13.21. 3 The cross-bar which joined the horns of a lyre and to which the strings were fastened Il. 9.187.

ζωαγρια.g: τά [ζωγρέω1. App. orig. the price paid for sparing a prisoner's life.] The price of one's life, a reward for preserving one's life by care or help Il. 18.407: Od. 8.462.

ζωγρεω1.g: [ζωός + ἀγρέω.] To take alive, spare a prisoner's life Il. 6.46 = Il. 11.131, Il. 10.378.

ζωγρεω2.g: [ζωή + ἀγείρω or ἐγείρω.] To re-assemble or rouse the vital forces of, revive Il. 5.698.

ζωη.g: -ῆς, ἡ [ζώω.] Life; hence, the means of living, means, substance Od. 14.96, 208, Od. 16.429.

ζωμα.g: τό [ζώννυμι. That which is girded about one.] 1 A waist-cloth or apron, prob. of leather, worn in warfare Il. 4.187, 216: Od. 14.482. 2 Something of the same kind, but doubtless of lighter material, worn in an athletic contest Il. 23.683.

ζωνη.g: -ης, ἡ [ζώννυμι.] 1 A girdle worn by a goddess or a woman: ζώσατο ζώνῃ Il. 14.181. Cf. Od. 5.231 = Od. 10.544. Fig.: λῦσε παρθενίην ζώνην (her maiden girdle) Od. 11.245. 2 The waist or loins of a man Il. 2.479, Il. 11.234.

ζωννυμι.g: Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ζώσαντες Od. 18.76. App. as 3 pl. pres. subj. mid. ζώννυνται Od. 24.89. 3 sing. pa. iterative ζωννύσκετο Il. 5.857. 3 sing. aor. ζώσατο Il. 14.181: Od. 18.67. Imp. ζῶσαι Od. 18.30. Nom. dual masc. pple. ζωσαμένω Il. 23.685, 710. 1 To gird up (a person) for action Od. 18.76. 2 In mid. a To gird oneself: ζώσατο ζώνῃ Il. 14.181 (v.l. ζώνην, put on her . . .). b To gird oneself up for action: ζώννυσθαι ἄνωγεν Il. 11.15. Cf. Il. 5.857, Il. 10.78, Il. 23.685, 710: Od. 18.30, 67, Od. 24.89. With acc. of what is girded on: κέλευσε χαλκὸν ζώννυσθαι Il. 23.130 (cf. v.l. under a and μίτρην, v.l. for μίτρῃ Il. 5.857).

ζωντοσ.g: contr. genit. sing. masc. pres. pple. ζώω.

ζωοσ.g: -ή [ζώω.] 1 Alive, living: ζωόν τε καὶ ἀρτεμέα Il. 5.515, ζωὸν ἕλεν (took prisoner) Il. 6.38. Cf. Il. 2.699, Il. 6.50, Il. 12.10, Il. 18.418, Il. 23.77, etc.: Od. 1.197, Od. 3.256, Od. 11.78, Od. 11.78, 86, Od. 14.272, Od. 19.272, Od. 23.55, etc. 2 Absol. in pl. a The living, those not slain: ζωοὺς σάω Il. 21.238. b Those yet in life: χαλεπὸν τάδε ζωοῖσιν ὁρᾶσθαι Od. 11.156. c The living, men: ὄφρʼ ἂν ζωοῖσιν μετέω Il. 22.388. Cf. Il. 23.47: Od. 10.52, Od. 14.487.

ζωροσ.g: Of wine, strong, unmixed. In comp.: κρητῆρα ζωρότερον κέραιε Il. 9.203.

ζωστηρ.g: -ῆρος, ὁ [ζωσ-, ζώννυμι.] 1 A warrior's belt Il. 4.132, 134, 135, 186, 213, 215, Il. 5.539, 615, Il. 6.219, Il. 7.305, Il. 10.77, Il. 11.236, Il. 12.189, Il. 17.519, 578, Il. 20.414. 2 A belt or girdle worn in ordinary life Od. 14.72.

ζωω.g: Contr. genit. sing. masc. pres. pple. ζῶντος Il. 1.88. 1 To be alive, live: ζώειν φασὶ μενοίτιον Il. 16.14. Cf. Il. 1.88, Il. 5.157, Il. 18.10, Il. 19.327, Il. 22.49, etc.: Od. 2.132, Od. 3.354, Od. 11.303, Od. 12.21, Od. 17.391, Od. 22.38, etc. 2 Absol. in pres. pple. pl., the living, men: ἀγαυότατον ζωόντων Od. 15.229. Cf. Od. 10.72. 3 To pass a life or existence of a specified kind: θεοὶ ῥεῖα ζώοντες Il. 6.138. Cf. Il. 24.526: θεοὶ ὄλβια δοῖεν ζωέμεναι (prosperity that they may pass their lives therein) Od. 7.149. Cf. Od. 4.805, Od. 5.122, Od. 17.423 = Od. 19.79. With cognate acc.: ζώεις ἀγαθὸν βίον Od. 15.491.
